_doc: How each concrete slot is spoken (doc 59 §4). A slot's CLASS decides its spoken domain; the render tool voices every value of a finite domain for every speaker who says that slot, and the director binds a slot only to a value whose clip exists. Classes: name (a person), org (a team or sponsor), series, route, number, ordinal, day, margin, clock, odds, phrase (NCM's own public sentences: Moody lines, Week PA steps, DNF causes). A slot not listed here is ABSTRACT: its line is optional when it is nothing but the slot, otherwise its beat waits for an authored fill.
